key.name: surface-matte
key.description: Solid frosted tone behind the tint; 0 keeps a clear-glass gradient.

key.name: pill-width
key.description: Width of the compact island in pixels.

key.name: expanded-width
key.description: Width of the expanded island in pixels.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Morph animation duration in milliseconds; 0 disables it.

key.name: disable-animations
key.description: Force instant open/close regardless of system animation settings.

key.name: hover-open
key.description: Expand the island after hovering the pill. Click always works too.

key.name: hover-open-delay
key.description: Milliseconds of hovering before the island expands.

key.name: hover-close-delay
key.description: Grace period before the expanded island closes after the pointer leaves.

key.name: move-clock
key.description: Move the notification/calendar button out of the panel center for the island.

key.name: enable-metrics
key.description: Show CPU, RAM, and network meters.

key.name: enable-audio
key.description: Show volume and output device selection.

key.name: enable-bluetooth
key.description: Show paired devices and the adapter power toggle.

key.name: enable-remote-art
key.description: Download HTTP(S) artwork through a bounded, host-checked, disk-cached request.
